scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-server-env.mjs && concurrently "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.db:generate: node scripts/ensure-server-env.mjs && npm run prisma:generate --workspace server
scripts.db:push: node scripts/ensure-server-env.mjs && npm run prisma:push --workspace server
scripts.db:seed: node scripts/ensure-server-env.mjs && npm run prisma:seed --workspace server
scripts.setup: npm run db:start && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
